theme_central: The truth of revelation and the folly of materialism, demonstrated by rational argument and history — with the exception of the people of Yunus, the only people whose last-minute faith was accepted.
sources_note: Part 1 (1-25, "the true thesis") sourced (karimabuzaid.com). The rest reconstructed from well-established landmarks: Musa/Pharaoh 74-93 (the drowning 90-92, very well known), the exception of the people of Yunus v.98.

branches.title: Opening, astonishment at revelation
branches.resume: The disbelievers' astonishment that a man should receive revelation, description of the Judgment, warning.

children.t: The wise Book, Allah established on the Throne, governs all things
Return to Allah, description of Paradise and the supplication of the chosen ones
If Allah hastened harm as He hastens good; the inimitable Qur'an

branches.title: The fleeting life, rational Oneness
branches.resume: Man forgets Allah in times of ease, a rational argument for Oneness, the challenge to produce a similar surah.

children.t: Parable of life as fleeting vegetation, the scene of Judgment
Who provides sustenance? A rational argument for Oneness
The Qur'an cannot be invented, the challenge to produce a similar surah

branches.title: Each people, its own term
branches.resume: A messenger and a fixed term for every community; the Qur'an as healing and mercy.

children.t: No one can hasten or delay the term fixed for each people
No compensation accepted at the Judgment; the Qur'an, healing and mercy

branches.title: Allah, witness to all things
branches.resume: Refutation of the idea that Allah would have a child; a brief reminder of the account of Nuh.

children.t: Allah, witness to all things; true success belongs to His allies
Refutation of the idea that Allah would have taken a child
Brief reminder of the account of Nuh and the flood

branches.title: Musa and Pharaoh
branches.resume: Confrontation with Pharaoh, the crossing of the sea, Pharaoh's drowning and belated repentance.

children.t: Musa sent to Pharaoh and the notables, the sorcerers' challenge
The timid faith of Musa's people, supplication against Pharaoh
Pharaoh's drowning, his belated faith rejected, his body preserved as a sign

branches.title: The exception of the people of Yunus
branches.resume: Faith must precede the sight of punishment — except for the people of Yunus; final instructions to the Prophet.

children.t: Confirmation by the People of the Book, faith no longer helps once punishment is seen
Exception: the people of Yunus believed in time and the punishment was lifted
No one believes without Allah's permission, salvation of the believers
Final instructions to the Prophet: follow the revelation, be patient
